input.summary: Insert mutual 12-month fees liability cap with self-identifying carve-outs after §21.2
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no aggregate liability cap, so we added a mutual cap of twelve months' fees and charges, with indemnification, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside that cap. This is our fallback position, and the Schedule B share limit in Subparagraph 21.2 is unaffected.

ops.text: 21.3 Except in respect of a Party's indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, its breach of its confidentiality obligations under Paragraph 31, its gross negligence or its wilful misconduct, none of which is subject to the limit set out in this Subparagraph 21.3, each Party's aggregate liability to each other Party arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the fees and charges paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. Nothing in this Subparagraph 21.3 prejudices the Schedule B share limitation in Subparagraph 21.2.
